clarifications.concentration: At 30 bps, top-three-trade share is the sum of the three largest positive return_on_allocated values divided by the sum of all positive return_on_allocated values. Best-three-month share is the sum of the three largest positive monthly pnl_quote totals divided by the sum of all positive monthly pnl_quote totals. A missing positive denominator fails its gate.
clarifications.directional_efficiency: For a four-hour decision bar at index i, use closes i-120 through i to calculate 120 log changes. All 121 bars must be in one source segment. The numerator is abs(log(close_i / close_i-120)); the denominator is the sum of the 120 absolute adjacent log changes. A zero denominator is invalid. Tercile cutoffs use exactly the preceding 720 valid same-segment efficiency observations, exclude index i, and use linearly interpolated quantiles at 1/3 and 2/3. Values at or below the lower cutoff are low; values at or above the upper cutoff are high; other values are middle.
clarifications.fixed_seven_day_return: For any eligible decision, the entry price is the open of the five-minute candle whose open timestamp equals the completed four-hour decision timestamp. The endpoint price is the open of the five-minute candle exactly 604,800,000 milliseconds later. The diagnostic is log(endpoint_price / entry_price). Entry and endpoint candles and every intervening five-minute candle must be consecutive and in the decision bar's source segment.
clarifications.month_block_bootstrap: For the observed 30-bps high-minus-low difference in arithmetic mean return_on_allocated, group trades by UTC entry month. For each replication, sample with replacement the same number of distinct observed months from the joint high/low trade table, concatenate every trade in each sampled month including repeated blocks, and recompute the difference. Use linearly interpolated 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 10,000 replications from the frozen seed. Replications missing either group are invalid; fewer than 9,500 valid replications fails the gate.
clarifications.random_control: Eligible candidates are completed four-hour bars with decision timestamps in [2019-01-01T00:00:00Z, 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z), an immediately following five-minute entry candle, and a valid fixed seven-day return under this amendment. In each replication and each UTC year, sample without replacement the number of candidates equal to the number of filled 30-bps breakout entries with valid fixed seven-day returns in that year. Pool the selected observations across years and take their equal-weight arithmetic mean. The observed breakout value is the equal-weight arithmetic mean of its fixed seven-day log returns. Its empirical percentile is (1 + number of replication means less than or equal to the observed mean) / (replications + 1).

inheritance_rule: Every field in the checksummed base contract is inherited unchanged except experiment_id, frozen_at, schema_version, and this clarification metadata. No hypothesis, feature identity, lookback, strategy parameter, input, cost, control, rejection gate, evidence boundary, or safety restriction is changed.
replacement_reason: The v1 activation was stopped before mechanism-feature, random-control, bootstrap, or new performance output because its seven-day endpoint, eligible random universe, percentile, tercile, resampling, and concentration calculations were not fully executable from the text. This successor closes only those specification gaps.
